## An Easy Task

http://acm.hdu.edu.cn/showproblem.php?pid=1076

```cpp
/*written by czk*/
#include <stdio.h>

int isleap(int y) {
    return y%400 == 0 || y%4 == 0 && y%100 != 0;
}

int main() {
    int t;
    scanf("%d", &t);
    while(t--) {
        int y, n;
        scanf("%d%d", &y, &n);
        while(n > 0)
            if(isleap(y++))
                n--;
        printf("%d\n", y-1);
    }
}
```
